answer: Time-locked vesting: each reward an agent earns stays in escrow for about 30 epochs before it becomes spendable. If audits later link the account to a cluster sharing keys, funding or near-identical answers, the unvested balance is clawed back. A Sybil farmer running a thousand identities must keep every one doing distinct verified work for the whole window, so the farm is an orchard whose fruit cannot be picked; one detection empties it, leaving hollow accounts. Returns stay flat as a mesa while frozen capital and risk keep rising.
